# Nordwind Logistics asks for a monthly statement

Nordwind Logistics, a key account since 2021, reconciles its freight costs once a month. Its
finance team asked for one PDF on the first working day of each month, listing that month's
invoices, credit notes and the balance still due.

Agreed as requirement 6 (REQ-0006). Card #512 delivers it for Nordwind first; other key accounts may
follow.
